MMSpower

MMSpower provides simple sample size, power and analysis calculations for malaria molecular surveillance (MMS) studies. It allows for imperfect diagnostic tests (sensitivity and specificity) and for clustered sampling across sites (intra-cluster correlation and the design effect).

What it covers

Each common study question has a design function, which tells you how many samples you need, and a matching analysis function, which tells you what your data show.

Question Design Analysis
How precisely can I estimate prevalence? design_precision() estimate_prevalence()
Is prevalence above (or below) a threshold? design_threshold() test_threshold()
Does prevalence differ between two groups? design_difference() test_difference()
What will the study cost? estimate_cost()

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mrc-ide/MMSpower")
